name: design-hub
description: OpenDesign + huashu-design + UI UX Pro Max in one MCP server, with a Superdesign-style live canvas. Runs only on Claude Code with your subscription — no API keys.

open_browser.title: Open the canvas in the browser
open_browser.description: ready: when a design is ready or waits for your choice; always: also on every new design; never: only when you open it

background_runs.title: Run Claude Code in the background for canvas requests
background_runs.description: When nobody is listening to the canvas, start headless Claude Code (your subscription, no API key) to handle what you send from the browser

runner_model.title: Model for background runs
runner_model.description: default uses the model from your Claude Code settings

port.title: Canvas port
port.description: Local port of the canvas web server (the next free port is used if it is busy)
